SELECT cls, boat,
  COUNT(*) AS trips,
  SUM(anglers) AS anglers,
  SUM(yt) AS yt,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 245 AND 305
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
GROUP BY cls, boat
HAVING SUM(anglers) >= 100
ORDER BY ypa DESC
LIMIT 25
